change_summary: Separate reusable-method qualification from owner placement so a wrong-Project Skill cannot demote a qualifying method into ordinary project prose.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill keeps exact continuation handles authoritative and requires qualifying reusable methods to reach the correct Project Skill owner even when a nearby Skill has incompatible scope.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-15.9 separates method qualification from destination reuse across MCP hosts while preserving Agent-owned planning and typed Runtime receipts.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.49 without changing transport, trust, consent, or compatibility-family boundaries.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.32; registry-backed update checks return an exact install command plus post-install verification, and Workspace capabilities expose server-owned limits.

help_center.note: Public guidance explains continuation subject authority and why wrong-Project owner mismatch does not negate evidence-backed Skill admission.

package_setup.note: Setup and SessionStart keep exact continuation subjects ahead of broad search and distinguish Skill qualification from placement without changing write consent.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owner history records the focused post-release evidence and keeps method qualification, destination authority and Runtime execution as separate decisions without adding a semantic fallback.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.49 publication and hashes can be verified here; Claude directory acceptance and fresh secondary-host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover continuation precedence, qualification-before-placement, durable method reconciliation, lossless line movement, adapter convergence, package export, and localized Help; fresh semantic reruns are the live behavior gate.
